title: Annotatio III §.VII open: POSTERIUS — CASSELLANUM (this century’s second Protestant-peace molimen) claims three peculiarities
pass_a_gloss: §. VII. The LATER Effort of Protestant Peace in this century, namely the CASSEL one, claims for itself three other peculiarities:
pass_b_english: §. VII. This century’s later Protestant-peace Consociation attempt — the Cassel one — claims three peculiarities of its own:
source_text:
§. VII.
POSTERIUS hujus Seculi Molimen Pacis Protestanticae, CASSELLANUM puta, tria alia sibi peculiaria vindicat:

lemmas.gloss: three other peculiarities belonging to it

choices.english: claims as its own / vindicates as peculiar

notes: Hexades Annotatio III §.VII open: POSTERIUS = CASSELLANUM (1661; cf. §.VI naming); three marks begin.
